decisions.statement: A field read off a name the file declares of its own is no ambient read.
A capture the closure itself declares again is not the outer capture.
A capture read but never called inside the closure is not judged.
A closure declared inside the capture's own extent is not judged.
The hook installers recognised are named in the code rather than worked out.

definition: whether a hook installed at load calls a field read before the field was published
